from collections import Counter


def confusion_matrix(data):
    counts = Counter((tuple(pair) for pair in data))
    TP, FN, FP, TN = (
        counts[1, 1],
        counts[1, 0],
        counts[0, 1],
        counts[0, 0],
    )
    confusion_matrix = [[TP, FN], [FP, TN]]
    return confusion_matrix
